purpose: complete drawn inbetweens between approved connection poses
prompts: Use case: illustration-story. Production sprite-animation INBETWEEN artwork. Draw EIGHT COMPLETE small mushroom-nest cels, 4 columns x2 rows, transparent RGBA background. All three attached images are APPROVED KEY POSE references, in order open, half-covered, fully-covered. These approved key poses must remain unchanged in our animation; your job is to freshly paint the intervening complete drawings, never cut, edit, stretch, or composite reference pixels. Match the exact salmon/ivory character, TWO pink eggs, clean dark outline, soft interior shading, upper-left highlight, fixed frontal camera. The ivory bowl/base remains the SAME shape and dimensions and remains grounded; the mushroom cap lowers around it like a heavy draping hood, progressively occluding the stem and eggs. Do NOT squash, shrink, melt or warp the eggs or bowl. TOP ROW left-to-right closure fractions 0.10,0.20,0.30,0.40: between open reference1 and halfway reference2. BOTTOM ROW left-to-right closure fractions0.60,0.70,0.80,0.90: between halfway reference2 and fully-covered reference3. In final cells almost all eggs are physically hidden by the front of the large drooping cap. No holes or gaps under the rim; always a connected complete natural drawing. Locked scale throughout all8 drawings, exact same body center and bottom baseline in each equal cell. Cap width about260 pixels in each384-pixel-wide cell, leave generous margins. All shapes entirely inside cells. All8 are small stage, no growth here. Request1536x1024 canvas, eight separate full sprites. Clean opaque painted interiors, closed smooth outlines, narrow antialias edges, zero alpha outside each silhouette. NO flecks, low-opacity spray, glow, shadows, ground, text, labels, borders or motion lines. These drawings are final production sources for smooth lowering, not a concept sheet.

The bowl and eggs remain fixed in shape and scale and on the ground. The large soft draped cap gradually lifts off the nest, revealing the ivory stem, eggs and right side mushroom through physical occlusion. No disappearing alpha, no squashed eggs/bowl, no holes or torn underside. TOP ROW left-to-right LIFT fractions0.10,0.20,0.30,0.40, between reference1 closed and reference2 half-raised. BOTTOM ROW left-to-right lift fractions0.60,0.70,0.80,0.90, between reference2 half-raised and reference3 upright. The FIRST drawings stay largely covered with only very small parts of the upper nest exposed. The LAST drawings are almost upright. Maintain character identity, scale, bowl/egg shape and markings consistently in every cell. Each sprite's cap width about320 pixels in each384-pixel-wide cell, empty margins at least25pixels. One constant scale for all8 sprites, fixed center and bottom baseline. All8 are the same adult stage; NO growth here. Request1536x1024 transparent canvas. Each is a complete freshly painted connected pose, not separated body parts. Smooth closed ink silhouette, opaque interior, narrow antialias, absolutely zero-alpha background. NO glow, spray, flecks, stray fragments, translucent residue, drop shadows, ground, text, labels, borders or motion lines. These are final production sources for the raise animation.
